title.narrative: Community-led multi-sectoral lifesaving assistance for IDPs and newly affected people in hard-to-reach and underserved areas in Kachin and Northern Shan State in Myanmar

description.narrative:
ltpgtThe current political crisis and resumption of intensified armed clashes in Kachin State and Northern Shan State led to increasing displacement and humanitarian needs. Currently, 46,498 people are displaced in Waingmaw, Mohnyin, and Shwegu Township in Kachin State and a total of 15,736 people are newly displaced. In the first quarter (Q1) of 2023, at least 26 armed incidents erupted, displacing some 1,200 civilians in Northern Shan State. The proposed project “Community-led multi-sectoral lifesaving assistance for IDPs and newly affected people in hard-to-reach and underserved areas in Kachin and Northern Shan State in Myanmar” provides emergency assistance in Education in Emergencies (EiE), Health, Nutrition, Protection, and Water Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) to disproportionately affected gender and age groups in 5 vulnerable townships across Kachin. Project oversight and technical leads AVSI Foundation and Myanmar Health Assistant Association (MHAA) together with local partners ltbrgt Diocesan Commission For Education (DCE), Dawn Peace Foundation (DPF), Grip Hands Organizations (GHO), Htoi San Land Development Organization (HSLDO), and Meikswe Myanmar Organization (MM), propose a harmonized approach to achieve better impact, leverage strengths, achieve program efficiency and value for money.lt/pgtltpgtltspangtltspangtltspangtAccording to the assessment conducted by the consortium, most of the sites require the establishment or re-establishment of schools nearby especially high schools including both infrastructure, materials, and service provision. For healthcare, most sites lack facilities, even before displacement. In these locations, villagers and community members need to continue accessing healthcare in the nearest village or town. In addition, most people lack knowledge of hygiene. It has been observed that some villages and IDP Camps need wells and safe toilets. Moreover, multiple shocks have left people living in their lives feeling helpless, prone to structural violence, abuse and mine risks. Vulnerable women and children are forced into behaviors that expose them to exploitation. Overall, these vulnerable groups are continuously prevented from accessing their rights. ltbrgtlt/spangtlt/spangtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspangtltspangtltspangtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/spangtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspangt
The project aims to improve access to Education, Nutrition, increase the community’s awareness and capacity to address women’s and children's rights, improve women’s participation community-level decision-making. For land mine victims, it provides Improved access to assistance. Lastly, Health services will prevent the spread of disease and infections and increase the accessibility of primary healthcare services by the IDP and Non-IDP populations aligned with the essential package of health services to affected and newly displaced people in 54 locations at Kachin State (Shwegu, Mohnyin and Waingmaw) and Northern Shan (Kutkai and Muse).
ltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspangt
Given this context, this grant request would prioritize women and children. All activities would mainstream C-19 prevention, women’s participation, accountability to affected populations (AAP) through ME and community feedback and complaints mechanisms. We will be guided by priorities in the First Standard Allocation (FSA) of the 2023 Humanitarian Response Plan (HRP), mainstream cross-cutting themes in protection, AAP, gender, disability inclusion Cash and Voucher Assistance (CVA).Particular attention is given to allocation strategies on 1. Age, gender and diversity - reaching the most vulnerable 2. Harmonized approach and complementarity - avoiding duplication 3. Localization - leverage partnerships with CSOs who have experience and access, 4. Centrality of Protection 5. Explosive Ordnance Risk Education (EORE) 6. Conflict sensitivity. Operational, security, safety and financial risk and the corresponding mitigating measures will be in place, risk registers will be regularly updated and communicated to project stakeholders. Sustainability or handover strategies including funding advocacy will be explored for the project’s duration.
